SELECT v.product_sku, v.record_path, v.brand, v.series, v.model, v.product_name, GROUP_CONCAT(p.property_key || '=' || p.property_value_text, '; ') as properties_list FROM product_variants v LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties p ON v.product_sku = p.product_sku WHERE LOWER(TRIM(v.brand)) = :brand AND (LOWER(TRIM(v.series)) LIKE :pattern OR LOWER(TRIM(v.model)) LIKE :pattern OR LOWER(TRIM(v.product_name)) LIKE :pattern) GROUP BY v.product_sku, v.record_path, v.brand, v.series, v.model, v.product_name LIMIT 10
brand=tikkurila
pattern=%tikkurila exterior tik 3pn-569 wood stain and deck oil%
